issues.title: Before you publish

codes.NO_ACCOUNTS: Choose at least one account to post to.
codes.LINK_INVALID: The link isn’t a web address. Use a full address starting with https://
codes.EMPTY_POST: {{network}} needs text, a link, a photo or a video.
codes.MEDIA_REQUIRED: {{network}} posts need a photo or video.
codes.TOO_MANY_MEDIA: {{network}} takes up to {{max}} files; this has {{actual}}.
codes.MEDIA_MIXED: {{network}} can’t mix photos and videos in one post.
codes.ASPECT_RATIO: {{file}}: {{network}} needs pictures between {{min}} and {{max}} (width to height); this one is {{actual}}.
codes.VIDEO_TOO_SHORT: {{file}}: {{network}} videos must be at least {{min}} long.
codes.VIDEO_TOO_LONG: {{file}}: {{network}} videos can be up to {{max}} long.
codes.LINK_NOT_CLICKABLE: Links in Instagram captions aren’t clickable, so the link isn’t added there. Put it in your bio or the first comment.
codes.LINK_CARD_DROPPED: With photos or a video, Facebook shows no link preview; the link is added to the text.
codes.FIRST_COMMENT_TOO_LONG: {{network}} comments can be up to {{max}} characters.
codes.FORMAT_NEEDS_VIDEO: An Instagram reel is one video. Attach a video, or post it to the feed.
codes.STORY_NO_CAPTION: Instagram stories don’t show text, so the text isn’t posted there.
codes.STORY_NO_COMMENT: Instagram stories can’t have comments, so the first comment isn’t added there.
codes.ACCOUNT_NOT_AVAILABLE: {{account}} ({{network}}) is disconnected. Remove it from this post, or connect it again.
codes.NETWORK_NOT_ENABLED: {{network}} isn’t set up on this server.
codes.MEDIA_NOT_FOUND: A file was deleted from the library. Remove it from the post.
codes.MEDIA_FAILED: {{file}} couldn’t be processed. Remove it, or upload it again.
codes.X_LINK_COST: X charges more for posts with a link.
codes.X_GIF_OR_VIDEO_ALONE: On X a GIF or a video goes alone: remove the other files, or post them separately.
